1.2.6.title: Ten New Themes
1.2.6.body: Sakura, Volcanic, Deep Sea, Honey, Plasma, Moss, Paper, Electric Blue, Tangerine, and Violet Night are now available in Settings and the profile theme menu.

1.2.6.title: Richer Active Session Cards
1.2.6.body: Active session cards now show transcoded progress as a lighter progress-bar overlay, while expanded cards include the viewer profile picture and a client icon beside the client details.

1.2.6.title: A Note About Today's Updates
1.2.6.body: We are sorry for the three updates in one day. Route and proxy changes touched the frontend, API, authentication, artwork, activity, and third-party integrations together, so several quick releases were needed while those connected response paths were brought back into sync.

1.2.6.title: More Reliable Pages
1.2.6.body: Activity now avoids blank loading states and theme-related table crashes, while release notes continue to work when GitHub is rate-limited or older beta version names are present.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Queue Rows
1.2.5.body: Queued Tdarr files now come from the same paged client data used by the Tdarr UI, so the Queue tab shows real media instead of only an aggregate count.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr History Rows
1.2.5.body: Finished and errored Tdarr jobs now display as history cards with the media name, posters, backdrops, finished format, source format, size changes, and saved space.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Refresh Reliability
1.2.5.body: Active, queued, and history response mapping now keeps worker progress, queue rows, history rows, and summary counts in the correct views.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Endpoint Handling
1.2.5.body: Tdarr refreshes no longer wait on the slow full database dump or blocking job-report lookups, keeping the dashboard responsive when optional endpoints are slow.

1.2.5.title: Tdarr Active Artwork
1.2.5.body: Active transcode posters and backdrops now stay matched during live polling refreshes instead of disappearing between updates.

1.2.3.title: 3rd Party Apps
1.2.3.body: JellyGlance now pulls Wizarr invites, Tdarr transcodes, Maintainerr cleanup, and SickChill series automation into one clearer `3rd party apps` setup area.

1.2.3.title: Wizarr Invites
1.2.3.body: Create, copy, open, and manage Wizarr invites directly in JellyGlance without bouncing out to another app.

1.2.3.title: Tdarr And Maintainerr
1.2.3.body: Tdarr now has clearer active, queued, and history views, while Maintainerr adds cleanup monitoring, summary data, alerts, widgets, and its own dashboard page.

1.2.3.title: Settings And Kiosk
1.2.3.body: Settings now uses cleaner categories with a collapsible sidebar, and Kiosk has its own custom controls for title, density, theme, visible widgets, widget sizes, and widget order.

1.2.3.title: Home And Hall Of Fame
1.2.3.body: Hall of Fame has been polished up, and Home plus Kiosk now give you better widget ordering, layout control, and dashboard customisation.

1.2.3.title: Requests Upgraded
1.2.3.body: Requests now has a richer display, newer features, and more advanced management controls for handling request queues and approvals.

1.2.3.title: Activity And Statistics
1.2.3.body: The `/activity` view is cleaner to scan, and `/statistics` now presents summaries and watch trends with stronger visual structure.

1.2.3.title: Profiles And Privacy
1.2.3.body: The profile modal has been cleaned up, logout now lives there, font-weight options are available, and Active Sessions privacy controls let you choose where viewer IPs are hidden.

1.2.3.title: Libraries And Users
1.2.3.body: Libraries and Users both had a broader UI overhaul, including better list views and the option to hide selected users from stats and activity when needed.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Big UI Beta
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Home, Settings, Statistics, Requests, Activity, Users, Libraries, Hall of Fame, Wizarr, About, and integrations all had a broader redesign pass with cleaner spacing, cards, controls, and layout polish.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Tdarr Transcodes
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Tdarr now has an Active Transcodes page with active, queued, and history views, navigation counts, show artwork, conversion details, and live progress updates.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Smarter Settings
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Settings now uses grouped categories, a collapsible sidebar, cleaner routes, custom Kiosk controls, privacy options, sidebar ordering, hidden tabs, and a safer theme preview flow.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: 3rd Party Apps
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Integrations are grouped more clearly with Wizarr for invites, Tdarr for transcodes, Maintainerr for cleanup, and SickChill as an alternative to Sonarr for series automation.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Cleaner Requests
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Requests now has richer media cards, an optional list view, requester profile pictures, admin user filtering, tidier actions, newer request features, and more advanced management for admins.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Kiosk And Privacy
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Kiosk mode can stay static, refresh every 5 minutes, and use custom title, density, theme, visible widgets, widget sizes, and widget order. IP visibility can now be controlled for Home, Kiosk, both, or neither.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Hall Of Fame Glow-Up
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Hall of Fame now uses a podium-style layout with medal icons, and hidden users can be filtered out of Hall of Fame, Statistics, and Activity.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Statistics Rebuilt
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Statistics has clearer summary panels, redesigned watch stats, profile pictures, client icons, stronger visual hierarchy, and media links through to JellyGlance media pages where possible.

1.2.3.beta.1.title: Sharper Polish
1.2.3.beta.1.body: Profile modal sizing, account labels, sidebar collapse, logout placement, profile hover pills, device icons, backup sizing, library and user list layouts, and several clipped or cramped screens have been cleaned up.

1.2.2.title: Invite People Faster
1.2.2.body: Create, copy, open, and remove Wizarr invite links without leaving JellyGlance. You can choose servers, libraries, access options, custom invite codes, and a wizard bundle ID when needed.

1.2.2.title: One Search for Requests
1.2.2.body: The Requests page now combines searching for new media and managing existing requests in one place, with faster filters, clearer cards, and request buttons that open the full setup flow.

1.2.2.title: Richer Media Details
1.2.2.body: Request details now show the information people actually check first: posters, summaries, cast, ratings, genres, requested seasons, requester avatars, and Jellyfin availability.

1.2.2.title: Better Activity Browsing
1.2.2.body: Activity history now includes media posters, cleaner title rows, and column controls so you can hide the fields you do not use.

1.2.2.title: Recently Added Filters
1.2.2.body: Recently Added now has search, media type and library filters, plus ordering controls for both items and shelves.

1.2.2.title: Profile Wrap-Up Improvements
1.2.2.body: User profiles now default to a clearer yearly activity heatmap, with a year selector, larger squares, and cleaner wrap-up cards.

1.2.2.title: Cleaner Settings
1.2.2.body: Settings tabs can be opened directly with links like /settings#plugins or /settings#apikeys, and the Plugins view now uses better Jellyfin artwork, spacing, and desktop card sizing.

1.2.2.title: Font Weight Preferences
1.2.2.body: The profile modal now lets you choose Default, Comfortable, or Light text weight, making JellyGlance easier to tune if the interface feels too bold.

1.2.2.title: Smarter Notifications
1.2.2.body: Invite events can now trigger webhooks, Invite Sync keeps links fresh in the background, Wizarr links copy with the correct public URL, and stable update checks ignore beta releases.

1.2.2.title: Email Wizarr Invites
1.2.2.body: Wizarr invites can now be emailed directly from JellyGlance using the built-in SMTP settings from Newsletter.

1.2.1.title: Jellyfin Jobs
1.2.1.body: Admins now get a dedicated Jellyfin Jobs page for viewing scheduled Jellyfin tasks, checking status, filtering by category, and starting jobs manually.

1.2.1.title: Cleaner Settings
1.2.1.body: Settings now has separate Authorised Devices and Plugins tabs, per-tab error boundaries, and a clearer embedded Repair section.

1.2.1.title: Smarter Navigation
1.2.1.body: Requests and Downloads now hide automatically when their services are not configured, while Jellyfin Jobs only appears for admins.

1.2.1.title: More Theme Choices
1.2.1.body: The profile theme picker includes more colour presets, with dark mode kept as the single supported appearance.

1.2.1.title: Activity and Logs Polish
1.2.1.body: Activity refreshes are calmer, table contrast is better, duplicate task toasts are reduced, and Logs is readable in the dark UI.

1.2.1.title: Release Notes on About
1.2.1.body: The About page now includes a release notes panel with a version dropdown and beta/stable release filtering.

1.2.1.title: No-Client Download Handling
1.2.1.body: Download queue sync now skips cleanly when no download clients are configured and avoids sending misleading completion notifications.

1.2.1.title: Security and Stability
1.2.1.body: The backend now has tighter CORS handling, security headers, body-size limits, rate limiting, skipped-task handling, and improved static asset lookup.

1.2.0.title: Quieter task notifications
1.2.0.body: Choose how much background task chatter you want to see, from every update to errors only, while manual actions still report back clearly.

1.2.0.title: Cleaner profile theming
1.2.0.body: The account modal now has a compact theme picker with colour previews, plus custom colour controls when you want a more personal dashboard.

1.2.0.title: Better newsletter previews
1.2.0.body: Newsletter setup now separates configuration from preview, renders the email in its own frame, and handles preview errors more gracefully.

1.2.0.title: Organized history imports
1.2.0.body: Jellystat and Tautulli import tools now live in clear Settings tabs, making legacy watch-history imports easier to find and manage.

1.2.0.title: Smoother mobile layouts
1.2.0.body: Headers, account controls, active session cards, import screens, and Settings navigation have all been tightened up for smaller screens.

1.2.0.title: Home starts with activity
1.2.0.body: New default home layouts now lead with Active Sessions, putting the live state of your Jellyfin server front and center.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Notification controls
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Settings now includes in-app notification controls so automatic task noise can be reduced while manual task feedback stays visible.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Profile theme picker
1.1.7-beta.3.body: The account modal now uses a compact theme dropdown with colour previews, with custom colours still available underneath.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Newsletter preview tabs
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Newsletter settings now separates configuration from preview, with the email preview rendered in its own document frame.

1.1.7-beta.3.title: Import tabs
1.1.7-beta.3.body: Jellystat and Tautulli import tools now sit behind clear tabs inside Settings for easier testing.

1.1.7-beta.2.title: Mobile app navigation
1.1.7-beta.2.body: The mobile bottom dock has been replaced with a full-screen app launcher opened from the JellyGlance header.

1.1.7-beta.2.title: Jellystat history imports
1.1.7-beta.2.body: The beta build keeps Jellystat and Tautulli history import work available for testing before the next stable release.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Beta channel
1.1.7-beta.1.body: This build is published from the BETA branch with its own prerelease versioning and Docker beta tags.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Jellystat history imports
1.1.7-beta.1.body: First-run setup can import Jellystat history alongside Tautulli so legacy watch data can come across before the first sync.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Smoother first-run setup
1.1.7-beta.1.body: After Jellyfin is connected, setup now moves into integrations, optional history import, and first sync without asking for the server again.

1.1.7-beta.1.title: Active session readability
1.1.7-beta.1.body: Long stream, subtitle, title, and user values now truncate more cleanly, especially on mobile session cards.

1.1.6.title: Tautulli history imports
1.1.6.body: Upload old Tautulli backups, preview them, append watch history safely, and repair unmatched media links.

1.1.6.title: Active session popouts
1.1.6.body: Click a live session card for a richer playback inspector with stream, device, user, progress, and transcode details.

1.1.6.title: Custom profile theming
1.1.6.body: New theme controls and presets let JellyGlance feel more personal across the dashboard.

1.1.6.title: Faster profile pages
1.1.6.body: Profile stats and media sections now load with targeted requests, cache reuse, and clearer loading counts.

1.1.6.title: What's new popup
1.1.6.body: JellyGlance now shows update notes once per version, with a manual button in the profile menu whenever you want to revisit them.

1.1.6.title: Activity refresh fixes
1.1.6.body: Activity pages now refresh after imports and handle imported history more reliably.

1.1.6.title: Better session readability
1.1.6.body: Active session timing and playback text have been tightened up so live cards are easier to scan.

1.1.6.title: Repair Hub
1.1.6.body: A new navbar page pulls media repair work into one place, including missing artwork, runtime gaps, empty series, orphaned activity, and unmatched imported history.

1.1.6.title: Newsletter generator
1.1.6.body: Configure SMTP, preview a JellyGlance digest, send test emails, and manually email recently added media, top watched items, active viewers, and repair status.
